steps.en: The screen tells the officer the rejection succeeded
steps.id: Layar memberi tahu officer bahwa reject berhasil

steps.en: The screen tells the officer the email was scheduled or sent
steps.id: Layar memberi tahu officer bahwa email dijadwalkan atau terkirim
steps.why_en: The prompt says the email was sent, not scheduled, since nothing is scheduled.
steps.why_id: Prompt menyebut email terkirim, bukan terjadwal, karena tidak ada penjadwalan.

steps.en: If reject or email fails, the screen shows that status
steps.id: Jika reject atau email gagal, layar menampilkan statusnya
